listing.name: Shin Megami Tensei NINE — SMT NINE Recomp (gymzatan)
listing.summary: Upstream exercised startup, save/load, movies, streets/shops, story battles, RTS tutorials and chapter2 entry. Explicitly no full-playthrough/stable60 guarantee. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Japanese retail Xbox disc; ISO/XISO or extracted default.xbe + Media; default.xbe SHA256 6c249401369ed41c2a319762f0b56b80aefde3efe766ac0d8731889a4150deac, complete 3515-file manifest. Chinese optional; English separately patched ISO imported after initial Japanese build.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source build setup.cmd/build.cmd; Windows Python3.14 + VS2022 + Rustup. Release assets are updates for an existing installation, not initial game packages.
